description.zh: 软件工程工作流：站会、代码评审、架构决策、事故响应、调试与技术文档。所有技能可独立使用，连接源码管理 / 项目跟踪 / 监控类连接器后体验更佳。
description.en: Software engineering workflows: standups, code review, architecture decisions, incident response, debugging, and technical documentation. Works standalone; richer with source-control, tracker, and monitoring connectors.

welcome_message.zh: 从代码评审到事故响应，把工程流程交给我
welcome_message.en: From code review to incident response — hand me your engineering workflows

zh: 帮我评审这段改动，重点关注安全、性能与边界情况
支付服务出现大量 503，按事故响应流程帮我处理：分级、沟通、缓解与复盘
服务间要不要引入消息队列？帮我写一份带权衡分析的架构决策记录
en: Review this change with a focus on security, performance, and edge cases
The payments service is throwing 503s — run the incident workflow: triage, communicate, mitigate, and postmortem
Should we add a message queue between services? Draft an architecture decision record with trade-offs

description.zh: 安全、性能与边界情况的结构化审查
description.en: Structured review: security, performance, and edge cases

prompt.zh: 帮我评审这段改动，重点关注安全、性能与边界情况
prompt.en: Review this change with a focus on security, performance, and edge cases

description.zh: 分级、沟通、缓解与事后复盘

prompt.zh: 支付服务出现大量 503，按事故响应流程帮我处理
prompt.en: The payments service is throwing 503s — run the incident workflow

description.zh: 带权衡分析的架构决策记录
description.en: An architecture decision record with trade-offs

prompt.zh: 服务间要不要引入消息队列？帮我写一份架构决策记录
prompt.en: Should we add a message queue between services? Draft an ADR

description.zh: 先复现、再隔离、最后定位原因
description.en: Reproduce, isolate, then find the cause

prompt.zh: 这个功能在预发正常、生产报错。请按调试流程帮我复现、隔离并定位原因，不要一上来就改代码。
prompt.en: This works in staging but fails in production. Debug it: reproduce, isolate, then find the cause before changing code.

description.zh: 核对迁移、开关、审批和回滚
description.en: Check migrations, flags, approvals, and rollback

prompt.zh: 这次发布包含数据库迁移。请按上线检查清单核对 CI、审批、特性开关和回滚触发条件。
prompt.en: This release includes a database migration. Run the deploy checklist: CI, approvals, feature flags, and rollback triggers.

description.en: A README, API note, or operational runbook

prompt.zh: 请为这个服务写一份技术文档，读者是新加入的工程师：怎么在本地跑起来、关键接口是什么、出故障先看哪里。
prompt.en: Write technical docs for this service for a new engineer: how to run it locally, the key APIs, and where to look when it fails.
